text.body: gautamī śikṣā sāmavedīyā gautamī śikṣā atha trayastriṃśadvyañjanāni bhavanti sparśāntasthoṣmāṇaśceti tatra kakārādayo makārāntāḥ sparśāḥ pañcaviṃśatiścatvāro'ntasthāste yaralavāścatvāraścoṣmāṇaste haśaṣasāścetyanekaṃ vyañjanaṃ yatroparyupari saṃyuktaṃ tatsaṃyogasaṃjñaṃ bhavati | ityasvaraṃ ca pūrvamakṣaram atha trividhaḥ saṃyogapiṇḍo bhavatyayaspiṇḍo dārupiṇḍastathorṇāpiṇḍaśceti yamasahitamayaspiṇḍam dārupiṇḍamantasthairyuktam yamāntasthavarjantūrṇāpiṇḍamityantasthayamasaṃyoge viśeṣo nopalabhyata ityaśarīraṃ yamaṃ vidyādantasthaḥ piṇḍanāyakaḥ 1 athānantyā viṃśatirbhavanti te kacaṭatapāḥ khachaṭhathaphā gajaḍadabā ghajhaḍhadhabhāścetyathāntyāḥ pañca te ṅañaṇanamāśceti athānantyāścatvāraste sayamāste kuṃ khuṃ guṃ ghuṃ ityanantyāntyasaṃyoge'nantyapūrve'nantyottare vyavadhānavarjite tatra yamā varttante na saṃśaya iti 2 atha sarveṣāṃ vyañjanānāṃ dvirbhāvo bhavati dvādaśākṣaravarjaṃ te khachaṭhathaphā ghajhaḍhadhabhā rahayośceti hakārasyaike manyante yadi bhavati rahayormadhye sarvatra svarātsaṃyogādiḥ krāmati rephahakāravarjam tābhyāṃ paraṃ krāmati na kramate paramupadhmānīyānusvārajihvāmūlīyānāṃ visarjanīyaparaṃ ca kṣaḥ tsapratyaye kṣaḥ tsapratyaye 3 atha dvyayakṣarāṇāmudāharaṇaṃ dvau takārau tasmātte sattamāḥ yathā priyavetteva bhavati dvau nakārau yannamasyanti śanno devīrunnayāmi | dvau jakārau yajjāyathā ujjihānā asthimajjeti dvau makārau yammitraṃ tammanye śammaghavan dvau cakārau yadadyakacca paramāccidyathāśu bhārgave sāmnyuccāte jātamandha3sāḥ dvau sakārau yassukṣitī punānasso'gnissamidhā dvau yakārau yathobhayyo dhānañjayyaḥ saharayyā nivarttasveti dvau dakārau yaddūre yaddidhṛkṣe moddālako hāruṇiḥ dvau lakārau svargāllokādūrddhvamullikherdobhirevainallokaiḥ dvau ṅakārāvṛśyavrate ṛśyāsa indrabhuṅṅiti maghavannindra bhuṅṅiti prabhuṅṅitī-ndrastasarapūtā 2345 evamādīni 4 cakārachakārāvindramaccheti takārathakārau vetthāhīti dakāradhakārau śuddhamiti bakārabhakārāvabbhakṣastṛtīyamiti yaṇve rephaṣakārāvarṣāsomadyumattama edaṃ barhiriti rahau vihrutamiti harau darśeti raśau sparśeti sapau dayau devasthāne dadyaurakrānbhūmiratanatsamudraṃ samacūkupadiṭ iḍā 2345 evamādīni 5 yāni cānyāni yathā karaṇe sarpasāmadharmarocanābhīvarteṣu saṃyamannavyāyamanviyamannasamāyamannudyullokānarocayohoyitaṃvo 3 dā 3 smāmṛtīṣaho vā yalavairdvirbhāvastaiḥ pūrvaḥ sānunāsikastulyasthānakaraṇapare kramapratiṣedhaḥ kramapratiṣedhaḥ 6 atha tryakṣarāṇāmudāharaṇamakṣaramiti kakaṣāstamṛbhvasambhavāḥ yacchikṣasi cacachāstvāmiddhi dadadhāstraiśoke śaśavā viśvohāi brahmeti hamamāḥ viṣṇuriti ṣaṇaṇāḥ pṛśniriti śaśanāḥ sṛprakarasnamūtaya iti sasanāḥ sārvakāmike nanakāḥ sarvān kāmānaśīmahī 2345 evamādīni 7 āmmre mamarāḥ dīrghe ragaghāḥ pādamadhye dadhayāḥ pādopāntīye nanatāḥ gauśṛṅge tatasāstaraṇiritsaṣāsatī 3 ṣaṭṭsu ṭaṭasāḥ khaḍge ḍaḍagāḥ kubje babajāḥ vajjre jajarāḥ dadarā varuṇasāmnīnduḥ samuddramurviyā vibhātīti 2345 evamādīni 8 ākhyātaṃ kakhayāḥ rakakhā mūrkkham ṅaṅakhāḥ śaṅṅkham patthyaṃ tathayā ñañajāḥ śārgehāvāñjātā 1234 yi viyañjate sa samañjate pūjjyaṃ jajayāḥ dūḍḍhyam ḍaḍhayāḥ tubbhyaṃ babhayāḥ sannṣaḍaha iti nanaṣāḥ rakakā arkkapuṣpe sāmnyarkko devānāṃ parame viyo viyo mā 2345 narkkasya devāḥ parame viyo viyo mā 2345 evamādīni tryakṣarāṇāmetadudāharaṇaṃ yathoktaṃ yathoktam iti prathamaḥ prapāṭhakaḥ 1 atha caturakṣarāṇāmudāharaṇaṃ sayamāyamābhyāṃ sayamāṃstāvadyathāgniriti dvau gakārau yamanakārau yajjñau iti dvau jakārau yamañakārau yunajmita iti dvau jakārau yama makārau vidmāhitveti dvau dakārau yama makārau samante dadhayamamakārā bharāmeddhmaṃ kṛṇavāmā havīṃṣi tāyi gṛbbhṇīta iti babhayamaṇakārāḥ unmṛdnītāniti dadayamanakārāḥ sagiḍḍhmeti ḍaḍhayamamakārāḥ pāppmeti papayamamakārāḥ vilambasauparṇe tatayamanakārā ityasya pratnāmanudyutamī ye iyāhāi evamādīni 1 atha yamavarjitānāṃ yathodaṅṅnyañceti ṅaṅanayāḥ kārṣmānvājīti raṣaṣamāḥ yadvīḍāvindra yatsthira iti tatasathāścandramā appsvantareti papasavāḥ hārāyaṇe gagadhayāḥ śaggdhyūṣvauho12 iśacīpatāyi kṛtsnamiti tatasanāḥ paṅktiriti ṅaṅakatāḥ sthirapsnūmiti papasanāḥ prāṅṅksuriti ṅaṅakasāḥ kaṇvarathantare rajajayā mārjjyamānassuhastiyā evamādīni 2 preṅkhāṃstarhyārohantīti rahahayāstathā bvrata iti babavavarāḥ samrājñīśvarāśśrvāmiti śaśaravāḥ matsyekṣeti tatasayāḥ śrautakakṣe nanadarāḥ indrāyamadvane sutamindrāyāmo vā ayajjvyaghaṭata iti jajavayāḥ kaṇṇṭhya iti ṇaṇaṭhayā vargāntya iti nanatayāḥ sunikktsīti kakatasāḥ rathantare raśaśayāḥ prāpnuvadarśśyāyato3vā evamādīni 3 atha pañcākṣarāṇāmudāharaṇam yathā jyotirggaurāyustryaha iti sasatarayāḥ saṅṅkṣṇutyeti ṅaṅakaṣaṇāḥ tasminntsvatantreti nanatasavāḥ viśvappsnyā iti papasanayāḥ ṅaṅakaṣavāḥ payasyagne yuṅṅkṣvāhi 1 3 yetavā pārṣṣṇyoriti raṣaṣaṇayāḥ śaggdhvyāṃroha iti gagadhavayāḥ pūrṇāññjvyotyāviti ñañajavayāḥ huvejasikrayaṇṇṭsvatāmiti ṇaṇaṭasavāḥ tārkṣyasāmnīti ra ka ka ṣa yāḥ tārkṣyamihā 1343 huvā 1 5 yimā 1656 evamādīni 4 atha sayamānyathā sabuddhnyā iti dadhayamanayāḥ duḥṣvappnyaṃ sviti papayamanayāḥ sārparājñyā iti jajayamañayāḥ māṭṭṇyā iti ṭaṭayamaṇayāḥ śudhye gaghayamanayāḥ patiṃ vo agghnyānāṃ dhenunāmiṣū'23dhyasā u vā sakthnyā iti kathayamanayakārāḥ prāthamavṛddhistnumūtaya iti sasatayamanakārāḥ prāggdhmākhapibāseti gagadhayamamakārāḥ mūrddhno viśaśvasyeti radadhayamanakārāḥ kāverajajayamamakārāḥ ityabodhādhiyagnirjjma udāyiti sūrā 13yā 2 evamādini 5 atha ṣaḍakṣarāṇāmudāharaṇamaṅge cakkmvyādāviti dvau kakārau yamamakāravakārayakārā iti satrakārtsnyā iti ratatasanayāḥ apsādhyarggdhmavāhamiti ragagadhayamamakārāḥ 6 atha saptākṣaramekamudāhṛtaṃ maṅke prātiśākhye hi na hi na dhuñughuñkṣuṅṅkṣkṣvāviti ṅaṅakaṣakaṣavāḥ gautamenoktaṃ na saptākṣarātparaḥ saṃyogo bhavatyeṣā sahasravartmātmā nānāvartivibhūṣitā saṃyogaśṛṅkhalā nāma sāmavedanibandhanāt 7 iti dvitīyaprapāṭhakaḥ iti sāmavedīyagautamīśikṣā samāptā
